# Tulipix

> Everything You Keep, In One Place. Software for your photos, music, videos, books and comics, kept on your own devices.

## Apps

- [Tulipix Manager](https://tulipix.pro/manager/): a free Android app (8.0+) that brings photos, music, videos, books, comics and PDFs together. Works offline, no account, no tracking. Get it on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.tulipix.phone) or as a direct APK download.
- Tulipix Companion and Tulipix For Desktop: coming soon.

## Tulipix Manager features

- Home: now playing, recent items and storage at a glance
- Photos and videos: browse by day, Memories from this day, places, videos that resume
- Music: songs, albums, artists, playlists, timed lyrics (optional, off by default), equaliser, sleep timer, Cast
- Books and comics: EPUB with read aloud, CBZ/CBR with strip mode and zoom, PDFs, Scan to PDF
- Search across songs, videos, photos and documents
- Home screen widgets in five styles and three glass strengths
- Encrypted Private folder opened with fingerprint, face or screen lock

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://tulipix.pro/manager/privacy/): no account or analytics; the only optional network request is a lyrics look-up to LRCLIB
- [Terms of use](https://tulipix.pro/manager/terms/)
